name: capstone-payment-latency-alert
description: Fires when p95 payment API latency exceeds the SLO (docs/operations/slo.md) for two consecutive 5-minute windows — avoids alerting on a single slow outlier request.
search: index=mortgage_dev service=mortgage-service path="/api/v1/mortgages/*/payments" method=POST | stats p95(durationMs) as p95_latency_ms | where p95_latency_ms > 500
alert_condition_note: Trigger action fires only when the search returns a row (p95 > 500ms); Splunk's consecutive-firing count (2) is configured in the alert's 'Trigger Conditions' UI, not expressible in this condensed JSON form.

webhook.note: Point at whatever paging/chat integration a real deployment uses — not configured here (no real endpoint).
